text:
Olivia (Events): quick heads-up — SF AI Week confirmed. We have a demo table + a 30min speaker slot on Thu 2pm. Booth: Peninsula Hall, Table P4. Need final swag list, demo laptop plan, banner copy, and lead-capture flow. cc @carmen @raj @tim

carmen (MarCom): budget? what's our cap for physical swag + shipping? also who owns the banner copy?

raj (Growth): excited — I'll take the speaker slot. laptop for slides + demo needed. AV check: HDMI + USB-C adaptors, mic? can ops confirm?

tim (Design): artwork deadline for print is 2026-04-28. If we miss that, printing is delayed. Who's finalizing copy?

mike (Ops): shipping window looks like 2026-05-08 -> 2026-05-10. Destination: Peninsula Convention Center (receiving dock). Recommend UPS Freight for crates > 50 lbs.

shipping-bot: Label created for 3 boxes -> tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 (auto)

carmen (MarCom): Proposed swag list — please review:
```
- 500 stickers (rounded logo)
- 300 tees (unisex S-XL)
- 200 neoprene laptop sleeves (branded)
- 250 notebooks + 500 pens
- 100 plush "redwood" seed toys
```

raj (Growth): can we swap 100 of the tees for 200 silicone phone wallets? those convert better on the floor. also need a 1-pager/pdf that links to our lead form so SDRs can follow up.

tim (Design): swap is fine. I'll update mockups and upload print-ready files by EOD Tue (2026-04-22). Will need final copy from @carmen by Mon.

Olivia (Events): quick action list — I'll own logistics signoff:
- @carmen finalize swag order + PO by 2026-04-24
- @tim upload final print assets by 2026-04-28
- @mike schedule carrier pickup 2026-05-10
- @raj provide slide + dev/demo build frozen by 2026-05-08
I'll confirm receiving address & lead-capture sheet later today. :thumbsup:

carmen (MarCom): noted. I'll draft banner copy and the 1-pager copy today and share for review.

raj (Growth): will set up a short signup flow (QR -> Typeform -> tag) and share sample by Fri.

mike (Ops): will send carrier contact details and crate spec (dimensions + weight) in a follow-up DM.

Olivia (Events): perfect. thanks team — let's sync briefly tomorrow 10am if anyone has blockers. :wave:
